html: Konbudj is a group name recorded for the northwest of Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory, shown on the map from 1600 to 1815 in a narrow strip of country east of the Mary River, near what is now Kakadu National Park. Little is known about the group, and the name may be an old spelling for one of the clans of the area. Its neighbours on the map are the Gaagudju to the east, the Iwaidja to the north and the Limilngan and Ngombur to the west and south.
